driver_cards.label: Natural Gas Price
driver_cards.interpretation: Weekly NG close used as the valuation dependent variable.

driver_cards.label: US Dollar (Broad)
driver_cards.interpretation: A firm dollar typically pressures energy commodities. Broad USD index at 120.75.

driver_cards.label: Working Gas Storage
driver_cards.interpretation: Storage is 156 Bcf above the 5-year same-week average (2827 Bcf), 5.5% surplus.

driver_cards.label: US Dry Gas Production
driver_cards.interpretation: Elevated production is typically bearish for price. Official dry natural gas production.

driver_cards.label: LNG Exports
driver_cards.concept: U.S. liquefied natural gas exports (not feedgas)
driver_cards.interpretation: Strong LNG exports are typically supportive for domestic prices (export volumes — not terminal feedgas).

driver_cards.label: Heating Degree Days
driver_cards.interpretation: Heating Degree Days: actual=0.0, week-of-year normal=0.0, anomaly=+0.00σ vs same-week climatology. Current HDD of 0 is a genuine midsummer observation (no heating demand), not missing data.

driver_cards.label: Cooling Degree Days
driver_cards.interpretation: Cooling Degree Days: actual=81.0, week-of-year normal=83.3, anomaly=-0.55σ vs same-week climatology.

driver_cards.label: Seasonality
driver_cards.interpretation: Informational only — not a validated Natural Gas seasonality valuation model. Historical Jul seasonality: avg weekly return -3.10% across 5 sample weeks in price history.

instrument.summary_text: Validated-driver fair value implies Natural Gas is approximately 2.7% overvalued. Validated drivers: Storage surplus/deficit. Largest log contribution: Storage surplus/deficit (-0.0851) — lowers fair value. Seasonality is informational only and is not included in fair value.

previous_unvalidated_snapshot.note: Prior unvalidated full-driver fit (for audit contrast)

working_gas_storage_level.reason: Displayed on storage card; regression uses surplus/deficit transform, not the raw level.

storage_surplus_bcf.reason: Surplus/deficit vs trailing same-week 5y average (no look-ahead).

dry_gas_production.label: US Dry Gas Production
dry_gas_production.reason: Improves OOS RMSE in D, but walk-forward coefficient sign flips — not stable enough for production fair value.

lng_exports.label: LNG Exports
lng_exports.reason: Improves OOS RMSE in D, but walk-forward coefficient sign flips — not stable enough for production fair value.

log_dxy.label: DXY
log_dxy.reason: Wrong economic sign in E (expected negative for stronger USD); excluded from fair value.

hdd_anomaly.reason: No material OOS improvement over storage-only; HDD insignificant (high p-value).
hdd_anomaly.hdd_zero_diagnosis: Zero is a genuine midsummer HDD observation, not missing data. Anomaly uses same ISO-week climatology (not annual sample mean).

cdd_anomaly.reason: Wrong economic sign vs cooling-demand expectation; not promoted.

seasonality_factor.reason: No validated Natural Gas seasonality valuation model; excluded from fair value.

model_comparison.selection_rule: Expanding-window walk-forward. Promote smallest nested spec with coherent economic signs that improves OOS RMSE vs constant baseline. Seasonality (H) is tested but never auto-promoted. Weather (F) requires >2% OOS improvement over storage-only.

contribution_breakdown.identity: log(fair) = intercept + Σ (βᵢ · xᵢ); fair = exp(log(fair))
contribution_breakdown.note: Contributions are in log-price points (exact). Additive USD decomposition is not applied because the model is fitted in log space.

hdd_cdd_diagnosis.hdd_zero: HDD=0 in midsummer is a genuine observation (no heating demand), not missing data. Anomaly is week-of-year climatology vs prior years only.
hdd_cdd_diagnosis.annual_zscore: Removed — invalid for seasonal weather series.

instrument.seasonality_decision: INFORMATIONAL ONLY — not included in fair value; no validated NG seasonality model.
